memories.content: Define in one sentence the user groups and usage contexts to which the design knowledge does not apply.
Reviewers judge the generalization boundary of results through explicitly excluded targets and situations.
Specify user goals, interaction conditions, and technological constraints under which the proposed design knowledge can be transferred.
Small-scale formative studies can support analytic generalization distinct from statistical representativeness when results are expressed in terms of design conditions and mechanisms.
The author of this proposal tends to apply design knowledge derived from an accessible sample to a broader user population.
Mark unverified schedule assumptions as such.
Mark unverified recruitment assumptions as such.
Mark unverified technical assumptions as such.
Trace back the resources required for each core prototype feature and field research procedure.
Operations reviewers judge feasibility by examining the personnel required for each procedure.
Operations reviewers judge feasibility by examining the equipment required for each procedure.
Operations reviewers judge feasibility by examining the time required for each procedure.
Document separately the commitments and confirmation status of field partners required for recruitment, installation, and operational support.
Designate a responsible party for software updates, equipment inspections, and user support during the deployment period.
The user's deployment readiness can be assessed only when dependencies on external services and field personnel are visible.
Field schedules and assigned personnel may change due to operational factors beyond the researcher’s control.

analysis.overview: The frames address complementary but independent concerns: the reference defines limits and transfer logic for design knowledge, while the compared frame documents operational feasibility, dependencies, responsibilities, and uncertainty. Neither frame supplies a scope-qualified counterpart to the other’s claims, and no conflict is present.

relations.reason: The reference memories express one one-sided claim linking a concise statement of excluded users and contexts to evaluation of the results’ generalization boundary.
relations.summary: Explicit exclusions define the boundary within which reviewers should judge the generalizability of design results.

reports.compared_only: The compared frame covers assumption labeling, resource-based feasibility review, partner commitments, deployment ownership, dependency visibility, and operational volatility affecting schedules and staffing.
reports.reference_only: The reference frame defines excluded populations and situations, transfer conditions, analytic generalization from formative studies, and a tendency to overextend findings from accessible samples.
